links.outcome: Model discrimination (AUROC) by self-reported race for HFNC failure prediction
links.effect: XGB model AUROC was significantly worse in Black patients than White patients (0.663 vs. 0.808, p = 0.02), despite overall AUROC of 0.707.
links.quote: XGB model had significantly worse performance in Black patients compared with White patients (AUROC 0.663 vs. 0.808, p = 0.02).

links.outcome: Discrimination of ML models versus ROX index for HFNC failure
links.effect: XGB AUROC 0.707 was the only model significantly better than the ROX index (AUROC 0.616).
links.quote: eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGB) model had the highest area under the receiver-operator characteristic curve (AUROC) for predicting HFNC failure (0.707), and was the only model with significantly better performance than the ROX index (AUROC 0.616).

screen.reason: Evaluates racial bias/disparity in predictive models for HFNC failure, fitting equity/safety criteria for empirical health AI, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
